overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair's reply-all email was a personal conflict with a member of the public, not deliberation on committee business. The AG cautioned against reply-all use but ordered nothing.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the chair's reply-all email to the committee, responding to a complaint about meeting notice, was an improper deliberation outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Regardless of whether the "reply all" was purposeful, the content of the email was not deliberation as it did not concern the business of the Committee, but was instead a conflict between Dr. Elbirt and the complainant, who is a member of the public.
